color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Views room photos and
descriptions; books a room
type or a specific room on
web or mobile.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Front desk (phone and walk-in
bookings with a payment link,
check-in / out), hotel
manager (replacement rooms),
housekeeping supervisor (cart
queues).

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div:
Hotel staff on cleaning
carts: clean and repair rooms
in priority order.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Lets guests pick a specific
room, keeps room-nights and
room status, directs
housekeeping by priority.
Service-based, five services.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div:
Existing system: non-pool
reservations, prices, stay
settlement and refunds at
checkout, cancellations,
manager reports. No API, only
file exchange. Blocks a room
pool that only we sell.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Lock vendor API: mobile keys
that open doors from a phone.
A key stored in the phone
opens the lock even while our
system is down; key cards at
reception are the fallback.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.div:
External payment operator:
hosted payment page, card
pre-authorisation at booking.
We never see card data.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Signs in guests and staff
(OIDC: OpenID Connect).
